application_guards: refund and revision quota locked transactions
lease fence and tombstone before publish
Agent session/workspace/turn composite references must resolve to the same owner/task/run; null run allowed only for preflight operation.
Do not resume thread by client-supplied ID or --last; exact persisted owner/workspace mapping required.
Session logs, scripts and checkpoints contain source data; revoke/erase with task and replay deletion tombstones before recovery.
One active turn/session; lost lease revokes publication and stops process tree before reassignment.
No customer Task/upload before owner session READY with complete Skill preload receipt.
New paid Run requires confirmed plan/binding and server-confirmed original payment; no consumer free_grant.
Commit nine independent result objects plus cleanup outbox before runtime destruction; result must not point into workspace.
Purge ephemeral DB source/analysis/context bodies and raw traces on cleanup; retain only result projections and minimal receipts.
CLOSED runtime cannot resume; new rework begins at S1. Source originals no longer available after cleanup.
agent_runtime_note: 64 reference tables. Session exists before Task; run absent until payment; results independent of cleanup. RLS and real execution remain unverified.
cleanup_semantics: Retention categories select a field-level purge policy, not blind row deletion. Keep minimal task/run/source/session tombstones needed by result/order foreign keys; clear all runtime body/object refs and physical copies. Materialize result evidence in independent storage before purging source runtime; never cascade-delete result tables.
